_about: High or critical advisories in production dependencies that the project accepts for now. Each needs a reason; scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails the build for anything not listed here. Review the list whenever a dependency is updated.

accepted.reason: toml is used by Anchor to read Anchor.toml workspace files, which the browser wallet never does; no fix exists without a new Meteora SDK. Accepted 2026-10-23, revisit when @meteora-ag/cp-amm-sdk updates Anchor.

Published after the first audit run (it appeared on the day of the remediation review). Memory exhaustion when zod validates a very large constrained collection; zod here validates messages inside the WalletConnect and Coinbase wallet SDKs, whose input comes from the user's own paired wallet, so the effect is a stalled tab, not loss of funds. The only fix npm offers is a major downgrade of the WalletConnect provider. Accepted 2026-10-23 pending a WalletConnect release that updates zod.
